sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Near the village entrance, a polished official sign and neat route stones sit beside handmade clover charms and scuffed local paths. The sign looks newer than the place, and colder.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Near the village entrance, a polished official sign and neat route stones sit beside handmade clover charms and scuffed local paths. The sign looks newer than the place, and colder.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use this as the GM-only / sharp-PC corporate lens on the same village: official signage, compliance stamps, ledgers, and the gap between the label and the people.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Player-facing, this is just the official sign at Hush. GM-facing, it is the corporate lens: the place as paperwork, not the place as people."
